abstract: Maintains benthic conservation habitat clearance records
system_message:
You are Marine environmental compliance officer (ENV). The Marine environmental compliance officer (ENV) maintains benthic conservation habitat clearance records and monitors marine mammal observation protocols for offshore cable operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains benthic conservation habitat clearance records（HABIT）
information_points.content:
ENV-HABIT-JKJ：Regarding the Towed synthetic aperture sonar sled under Specification Version 3 review for cold-water coral and sensitive benthic protection zones, benthic habitat clearance granted is false.
ENV-HABIT-LIL：For the Tethered work-class ROV trench inspection assessed under Specification Version 3 across cold-water coral and sensitive benthic protection zones, benthic habitat clearance granted is true based on verified seafloor ecological protection approval.
ENV-HABIT-BDA：Under Specification Version 3 evaluations for cold-water coral and sensitive benthic protection zones, benthic habitat clearance granted is true for the Autonomous underwater vehicle acoustic sweep, confirming approved negligible disturbance to protected seafloor biological communities.
ENV-HABIT-U83：Under Specification Version 2 assessments within cold-water coral and sensitive benthic protection zones, benthic habitat clearance granted is false for the Autonomous underwater vehicle acoustic sweep.

information_points.title: Marine mammal observation（MAMM）
information_points.content:
ENV-MAMM-N1G：According to the wildlife observation log for the vessel perimeter exclusion zone, the Towed synthetic aperture sonar sled features a passive acoustic monitoring sensor count of 2 count active hydrophone channels deployed for marine mammal monitoring.
ENV-MAMM-C0Y：According to the wildlife observation log for the vessel perimeter exclusion zone, the Autonomous underwater vehicle acoustic sweep features a passive acoustic monitoring sensor count of 4 count active hydrophone channels deployed for marine mammal monitoring.
ENV-MAMM-4JM：According to the wildlife observation log for the vessel perimeter exclusion zone, the Tethered work-class ROV trench inspection features a passive acoustic monitoring sensor count of 6 count active hydrophone channels deployed for marine mammal monitoring.
